meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Codex 接进工作流,让它替代或辅助 Claude 规划并执行编码任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在用 Claude 做编码 agent,想换成或补上 Codex
copy.tagline_en: Plug Codex in to plan and run coding tasks, alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a coding agent and want to swap in or add Codex

howto.what: 装上后,这个技能把 Codex(OpenAI 的 codex app-server)安装成 NanoClaw 的代理后端,让指定群组的规划、工具编排、MCP 工具和会话续接交给 Codex 而非 Claude。凭证只放在 OneCLI vault,容器里读不到真实密钥。
howto.when: 装完后默认仍是 claude;需要由操作者在宿主机手动执行 ncl groups config update --provider codex 并重启该群组,它才会接管这个群组的代理工作。

say.text: 把群组 <group-id> 的 provider 改成 codex,然后重启它
say.note: 执行配置更新并重启该群组

say.text: 跑一下 Codex 的认证,用 ChatGPT 订阅登录
say.note: 写入 OneCLI vault,已有密钥会跳过

say.text: 把新建群组的默认 provider 设为 codex
say.note: 改 DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER 并重启宿主

howto.what_en: Installs Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a NanoClaw agent provider, so a group's planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, and session resume run on Codex instead of Claude. Credentials stay vault-only in OneCLI.
howto.when_en: After install the default stays claude; an operator must run ncl groups config update --provider codex and restart the group before it takes over.

say_en.text: Switch group <group-id> to the codex provider and restart it
say_en.note: Updates config and restarts that group

say_en.text: Run the Codex auth walkthrough with a ChatGPT subscription
say_en.note: Writes to the OneCLI vault; skips if set

say_en.text: Set the default provider for new groups to codex
